results.title: Trump's Approval Turns Negative in 11 Red States He Won by Double Digits According to Civiqs Online Poll

results.content:
President Donald Trump’s approval rating is underwater in 11 states that the president won by double digits in the 2024 election, Newsweek reports, a potentially troubling sign as the crucial fall midterm elections approach.

Trump has a 36% approval rating nationwide, according to Civiqs’ online tracking poll of registered voters.

The president’s disapproval rating is 59%, the rolling poll shows, leaving Trump deeply underwater with a net approval rating of -24%. [...] The rolling poll of registered voters has received more than 120,000 responses since Jan. 20, 2025, when Trump returned to the White House for a second term.

results.title: As midterms loom, devastating poll shows Trump has negative approval in 11 states he won in 2024 - silive.com

results.content:
State-by-state data shows Trump underwater in every swing state, meaning even small shifts in voter sentiment could help determine control of Congress in November.

The data comes from Civiqs’ rolling online tracking poll of 120,580 responses from registered voters.

#### Read More on Politics [...] Trump remains weakest among younger voters. Among those aged 18 to 34, just 22 percent approve of his job performance, compared with 72 percent who disapprove, according to the newest Civiqs data.

Among voters aged 35 to 49, approval stands at 29 percent, while 63 percent disapprove.
